description: Technical indicators for one crypto pair and interval, computed from the last 60 to 300 candles: SMA and EMA for the periods you give (default SMA 20, 50, 200; EMA 12, 26), RSI 14 (Wilder), MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger 20/2, ATR 14, the latest values, and a plain trend note (above or below the 200 average, overbought or oversold). Candles come from Coinbase; the newest candle may still be forming. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ema.description: Comma-separated EMA periods, up to 5, each 2 to 200 (default 12,26)

pair.description: Coinbase pair like BTC-USD or ETH-USD

sma.description: Comma-separated SMA periods, up to 5, each 2 to 200 (default 20,50,200)

name: crypto_indicators
title: Crypto Indicators
